text:
About **2.2%** of the property was affected: 81.3 ha of tree-cover loss in 2021, out of 3,643.5 ha (Hansen Global Forest Change).

- **Corroboration:** The JRC 2020 forest map shows 98% of the loss area was forest in 2020, and later years of the series are observed, so the event meets the corroboration rule.
- **Forest type:** According to the 2021 national forest map, 68.1 ha was planted pine (*Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*), 13.2 ha was outside mapped forest, and none was native forest. The data does not state the cause, so I can't say whether this was harvesting.
- **Excluded:** A further 37.3 ha of loss was in patches under 0.5 ha. These are not counted as events and are not in the 2.2%.
